title: Zehra Tera Gulshan
body:
gulshan e zahra gulshan e zahra
fatema zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
zahra tere gulshan ka har phool niraala hai
har phool ne sar de ke islam ko paala hai
<<DIVIDER>>
afsos musalmano ashoor ko maqtal may
quran ke paaron ko naizo pe uchaala hai
har phool ne sar deke islam ko paala hai
zahra tere gulshan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay maut kabhi tu ne zainab se nahi poocha
athara baras kaise is sher ko paala hai
har phool ne sar deke islam ko paala hai
zahra tere gulshan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
bas qabr hi zahra ki doobi hai andhero may
haalan ke madine may har simt ujaala hai
har phool ne sar deke islam ko paala hai
zahra tere gulshan ka...
<<DIVIDER>>
sarkar e mohamed ho ausat ho ke aakhir ho
zahra ke charaagon se har simt ujaala hai
har phool ne sar deke islam ko paala hai
zahra tere gulshan ka...
author: Raza Sirsvi
